name: Facet
text: We should default to a dark theme for our interface, as it will provide better visibility and reduce eye strain for our users. This decision is based on the success of similar dark-themed interfaces, such as Manus Competitive Analysis and Graphify Dashboard. By doing this, we're accepting the trade-off that some users may initially be put off by the dark theme, but this will be mitigated by hiding the theme toggle for the first 30 days, allowing them to adjust. This approach will ultimately lead to a more enjoyable and clear user experience, which aligns with our goal of creating an engaging and effective interface.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t just extra design work—it’s that hiding the light mode toggle for the first 30 days could alienate users who prefer light themes. A better alternative is to default to dark but expose the toggle immediately, letting usage data settle the argument in two weeks.
